notes: «روى حماد وأنس عن أبيه جميعا عن جعفر»: the two co-transmitters meet at Ja'far, after the bare relation «أبيه» (Anas's father)
«عن أبيه عن جده» on the Ja'far line are bare relations; Ali is the last link
the Prophet («عن النبي») is the end, not a link
«وَ رُوِيَ شَرِّهِ» is a wording variant and «قَالَ عَلِيٌّ» inside the saying is part of the matn: left out
